meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标，用绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行、红点表示已停止，并提供启动、停止、重启的控制。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时接管。仅限 macOS，且需要已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools（swiftc）。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude adds a macOS menu bar bolt icon for NanoClaw: green dot means running, red means stopped, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a NanoClaw menu bar status indicator on macOS. macOS only, and requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc).

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status icon to my menu bar
say_en.note: Compiles a Swift binary and installs it via launchd

say_en.note: Uses launchctl to see if a PID is returned
